rankruletxt:
1.Every time you win a gold coin, you will get a little profit point, and 
some games even double the profit.
2. Points are awarded only for betting on games with specific points.
3.The top ten players on the daily leaderboard can get ranking 
rewards and league points!
4. The top ten players in the weekly list can get generous league 
bonuses!
5. Calculate the previous day's daily ranking and distribute rewards 
every day.
6. The weekly rankings for the previous week will be settled every 
Sunday and rewards will be distributed.
7. Rewards must be claimed within 24 hours, expired and invalid.
ruletxt:
1.Players can place cost on the fruit or 77 they 
predict the wheel will stop on, in order to earn 
rewards.
2.Players need to select the cost amount before 
starting the game.
3.Players can choose fruit or 77 on the wheel.
4.lf the result matches the player's choose, they will 
receive rewards based on the odds.
5.Different options have different odds, players can 
analyze the probability of options by observing the 
game history.
6.When lucky 77 occurs, there is a chance to hit 
multiple awards at the same time.
